body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes CI failures by addressing TypeScript type errors, aligning the example DataSource implementation with updated interfaces/client APIs, and cleaning up ESLint violations across tests and mocks.

**Changes:**
- Hardened ObjectGrid union narrowing and removed unsupported `DropdownMenuItem` props.
- Updated the MSW example’s ObjectStack client integration (meta/data API changes) and DataSource return types.
- Cleaned up tests to satisfy updated driver/query requirements and lint rules (e.g., `@ts-expect-error` usage, unused imports).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Fixes union narrowing for `dataConfig` and removes unsupported `DropdownMenuItem` prop. |
| packages/core/src/query/__tests__/window-functions.test.ts | Replaces `@ts-ignore` with `@ts-expect-error` to satisfy ESLint rules in tests. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/mocks/server.ts | Adds `@ts-expect-error` for out-of-src config import and type-asserts protocol service access. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/mocks/browser.ts | Adds `@ts-expect-error` for out-of-src config import. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/dataSource.ts | Updates ObjectStack client calls and adjusts DataSource method return types to match `@object-ui/types`. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/__tests__/ServerDefinitions.test.tsx | Removes unused imports and loosens assertion to account for optional `data`. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.test.tsx | Instantiates/initializes `ObjectStackClient` explicitly and removes unused variables/imports. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/__tests__/ObjectFormUnit.test.tsx | Updates mock DataSource to match updated interface return types and removes unused params. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/__tests__/ObjectForm.test.tsx | Updates driver queries and client API calls; removes unused `userEvent` usage. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/__tests__/MSWServer.test.tsx | Updates driver query params and adds a type assertion for driver create return. |
| examples/msw-object-form/src/__tests__/Dashboard.test.tsx | Updates driver query params and adds a cast for the returned contacts list. |
</details>

This adapter is declared as `implements DataSource`, but several method signatures still don’t match the `DataSource` interface in `@object-ui/types` (e.g., `findOne`/`delete` use `id: string` instead of `string | number`, and `findOne` doesn’t accept the optional `params?: QueryParams` or return `T | null`). Even if TS allows this structurally, it weakens the purpose of the interface and makes it harder to swap adapters. Align these method signatures with `DataSource` (see `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`).

`kernel.getService('protocol')` is cast to `any`, which removes all type checking for the protocol handlers used below. Since this file directly calls a known set of methods (`handleDiscovery`, `handleFind`, etc.), consider defining a minimal local interface for the protocol service (or importing the proper type if exposed by `@objectstack/runtime`) and casting to that instead of `any`.

Removing the unsupported `variant="destructive"` fixes the type error, but it also removes the visual affordance that this is a destructive action. Consider adding an explicit destructive style via `className` (e.g., `text-destructive` / `focus:text-destructive`) so the Delete menu item remains clearly differentiated.
```suggestion
              <DropdownMenuItem
                onClick={() => onDelete(row)}
                className="text-destructive focus:text-destructive"
              >
```
